# Solve-time (AGENT) Python dependencies — the minimal runtime the prompt's local
# dev loop needs: numpy + CPU torch, enough to `import varseq.oracle`, call
# `load_oracle()`, and run a numpy/torch design search against it.
#
# Installed at setupProblem (image-BUILD) time into an agent-owned venv
# (workspace/.venv) — the SOLVE phase has no internet, so the agent cannot
# install anything itself; provisioning must happen at build. Kept deliberately
# SLIM (NOT the full grade closure in requirements-test.txt): baking the whole
# multi-GB runtime into the image is wasteful, and every observed rollout drives
# design() with numpy/torch alone (the heavy varseq toolbox is not load-bearing —
# see task-docs/seq-design/build-log.md tool-ablation result). Pins match the
# grade closure so local dev behaviour matches grading.

numpy==2.0.2
